newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian troops arrive in Albanian port.
newsitem.headline: Italian troops arrive in Albanian port.

text.p: The vanguard of a multinational military force arrived in the Albanian port of Durres on Friday, eyewitnesses said.

A 20-strong advance unit of Italian troops, spearheading a 6,000-strong force charged with protecting aid convoys to the stricken state, reached the port of Durres after sailing across the Adriatic from the Italian port of Brindisi on Thursday evening.
The advance unit was drawn from an army pioneer regiment and was accompanied on the navy transport ship Pantelleria by a number of crack marines.
The unit's task is to inspect the area where the main landing will take place and reconnoitre the road from Durres to the capital Tirana, military sources in Rome said.

The bulk of the force, the first of its kind led by Italy, is due to begin deploying next Monday on a mission to assist the delivery of relief aid to impoverished Albania, brought to the brink of collapse by an armed insurrection last month.
